**The meaning of the verses**
﴿وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَا أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا﴾

Your Lord, O man, has commanded, made binding and obligatory that He alone, glorified and exalted is He, be singled out for worship, and He has commanded kindness to father and mother, especially in old age if they are in your care. So do not become impatient or find burdensome anything you see from one or both of them, and do not let them hear a bad word, not even "uff," which is the very least of bad words, and let no ugly deed come from you towards them. Rather, be gentle with them, and always speak to them with soft, kind words.

﴿وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا﴾

Be humble and lowly towards your mother and father out of mercy for them, and ask your Lord to have mercy on them with His vast mercy, in life and after death, just as they were patient in raising you when you were a child with little strength and ability.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. What did Grandpa Uthman use to do for Idris when he was small? And what did Idris do to his grandfather on the day he saw his friend Ilyas?
2. What did Idris see when he turned around? And what did he learn from his grandfather and from his mother about when he was small?
3. What does "as they raised me when I was small" mean? And why is the grandfather included in it, when it is about the parents? (The grandparents are the parents' parents, and being dutiful to them and honouring them is part of the dutifulness Allah has commanded.) And how did Idris come to "carry" his grandfather?

**This week's exercise**
Your child chooses a day this week to be the companion of their grandfather, grandmother or one of their parents: carrying what they need for them, walking at their pace, and giving them something they love, bought from their own pocket money. And every night they make du'a for their parents with the du'a in the verse.
